description: Chunk proofs, leaf to root, one lowercase hex string (spec §5, §10). Mainnet geometry, mod251: every chunk of each full upload with chunk count 1 through 17 (chunk count 5, chunk index 4 is the one-sibling proof, spec §4), and chunks 0, 2047, and 4095 of 1 GiB. Testing geometry, mod251: every chunk of the printed 112-byte upload, including chunk 2. size_proof is true when chunk_index is rightmost_chunk(data_size) = chunk_count - 1, computed from data_size (spec §5, §9). Every upload here has that case.
